note: Which 2020 block count weights each table's counts when a 2010-tract period is moved onto 2020 tracts (etl/harmonize.py). Methods audit 2026-11-17: one total-population weight for everything lets dorm and prison blocks pull household and housing measures; NHGIS ships separate population, household and housing-unit weights for this reason. A share's numerator and denominator come from one table, so they always use the same weight. Bases come from the 2020 PL 94-171 file: pop = P1_001, hhpop = P1_001 - P5_001 (population outside group quarters), hh = H1_002 (occupied units = households), hu = H1_001.

pop.why: Universes include group-quarters residents (total population, population 25+, 16+, workers).

hhpop.why: Poverty status excludes institutional group quarters and college dorms; disability and insurance cover the civilian noninstitutionalized population. Household population is the closest PL base.

hh.why: Universes are households or occupied housing units (owner- or renter-occupied). B28002 (internet subscriptions) covers households.

hu.why: Universes are all housing units, occupied or vacant.
